title: On Whether the Kettle Knows It Has Boiled
author: M. Halvorsen, Independent
verdict: The author proposes a theory of kitchen appliance consciousness and supports it with eleven observations of a single kettle. The methodology is charming. The conclusion is that the kettle is not there when no one is watching, which the editor finds difficult to dispute on the evidence presented. Declined.

title: A Longitudinal Study of Reply-All Emails and Their Discontents
author: Dr. P. Oyelaran (pseudonym: The Office Ghost)
verdict: A thorough work with a regrettable sample size of one office. The editor was unable to determine whether the subject of the study was the reply-all or the reader. Declined, and the editor has asked that no further replies be sent to this office.

title: Toward a Unified Theory of the Second Pigeon
author: Anonymous
verdict: The first pigeon is taken seriously. The second pigeon is not. The manuscript repeatedly asserts that a pair is a system, a claim the editor has never seen supported. Declined, with the suggestion that the author consult the first pigeon.
